method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Snowball (雪球/雪玉)
skills.description: Yuki Onna throws a snowball at a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Has a 25% base chance of Slowing the target's SPD by 10, lasts for 2 turns.
Base chance of inflicting Slow increases to 50%.

skills.name: Ice Buffer (冰甲术/氷鎧の術)
skills.description: At the end of Yuki Onna's turn, she creates an Ice Shield, sustained for 1 turn, to protect herself and 2 allies with the highest Crit DMG. The Ice Shield can absorb damage equal to 6% of her max HP. ;Ice Shield (氷鎧) : :'''Buff, Status''': When an ally with Ice Shield deals damage to a enemy with Freeze or Deep Freeze, increases their ATK by 40% of their initial ATK.

upgrades.text: When attacked, her Ice Shield has a 25% base chance of Slowing the attacker's SPD by 10, lasts for 2 turns.
Base chance of inflicting Slow increases to 50%.

skills.name: Blizzard (暴风雪/吹雪)
skills.line: Nothing can escape my mighty blizzard.
skills.description:
Yuki Onna summons a blizzard to attack all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 30% of her ATK each time and has a 8% base chance of inflicting Freeze, lasts for 1 turn. The overall chance increases by 10% for enemies with Slow and the base chance increases to 25% when attacking monsters.
When she attacks targets with Freeze again, she has a 30% chance of converting it to Deep Freeze. If the target is a monster, Deep Freeze will instead become Freeze, lasts for for 2 turns.

upgrades.text: Has a 8% base chance of Slowing the target's SPD by 10, lasts for 2 turns.
Base chance of inflicting Slow increases to 16%.

bio.condition: Have Yuki Onna take part in 60 Realm Raids.
With Yuki Onna clear stage 7 of any Evo zone (solo).
